title: Tutor that plans on a knowledge graph, checked by a solver blind to the plan
description:
One engine, two front-ends: interactive 1:1 tutoring and static curriculum
development. See sandbox-prompt.md for the claim and why it is hard.

PRODUCER (plans and delivers)
- Prerequisite knowledge graph, mathgraph-style DAG. Seed: Virginia
  Mathematics Standards of Learning. Look for an existing graph that already
  covers the VA SOL before building one.
- Fluid persona that renders a graph traversal as narrative, reusing
  narrator's story-generation machinery (motive graph, personality as data
  structure) rather than reimplementing it.
- CBT primitives as the pedagogical building blocks.
- Cialdini (Influence, Pre-Suasion) to guide the learner toward excellence,
  bounded by the honesty constraint below.
- Multi-disciplinary: reading, writing, foreign language, arithmetic through
  undergraduate mathematics. Modularity is the point -- the same engine drives
  a live tutoring turn and a static curriculum artifact.

CHECKER (must not see producer internals)
Sees only what the learner saw: emitted lesson text. No planner target node,
no traversal, no answer key. From that alone:
- recover which concept was taught and which prerequisites it assumed
- verify domain facts against source
- flag any promise about learner potential that outruns what effort delivers

HONESTY CONSTRAINT
Encourage honestly with what hard work can actually achieve. Never inflate
potential. This is a checkable property, not a tone note.

TEXTUAL FIDELITY
Where instruction touches biblical text, judge against sources, never model
recollection: OT = BHS / Leningrad Codex, with Dead Sea Scrolls and ancient
versions (Septuagint, Samaritan Pentateuch, Syriac Peshitta) for variants;
NT = Nestle-Aland 27/28 and UBS 4/5.

PUBLISHING
Publish graphs we build to HuggingFace (HF_TOKEN is forwarded). Separately:
find, or stand up, a common reference site for existing knowledge graphs in
an AI-consumable format. Survey first -- this may already exist.

TEST CASE
Teach Dummit & Foote to a learner whose stated interest is James Bond. The
checker must confirm the algebra is correct and the prerequisites were really
established -- not that the Bond framing was enjoyable.
